title: Connections

notice.title: Generic OAuth2 connections (platform-agnostic)
notice.description: Configure standard OAuth2 authorization-code connections here: fill in the platform's authorization/token endpoints and client credentials, and after starting authorization paste the code from the callback page back into "Complete authorization". This version ships with no specific platform built in and does not automatically call any platform's business APIs.

empty: No connections yet; click "Create connection" to add one

deleteConfirm.title: Delete this connection?
deleteConfirm.description: The saved token will also be cleared, and this cannot be undone.

modal.secretKeepHint: Leave empty to keep the current client secret; fill in to replace it.

form.providerPlaceholder: e.g. generic / shopify (used as a label only, customizable)
form.clientIdPlaceholder: The client_id assigned by the platform
form.clientSecretPlaceholder: The client_secret assigned by the platform
form.clientSecretKeepPlaceholder: Leave empty to keep the current secret
form.clientSecretHint: Secrets are stored with server-side envelope encryption and are never echoed back in any list or detail view.
form.scopesHint: Separate multiple scopes with spaces; can be left empty.
form.redirectUri: Redirect URI (redirectUri; leave empty for the default)
form.redirectUriHint: Must match the callback registered in the platform console; leave empty to use the server default /connections/callback.

authModal.title: Complete authorization
authModal.hint: After approving authorization on the newly opened platform page, the callback page shows the authorization code and state. Paste them below (clicking "Authorize" already filled in state); on submit the server exchanges and encrypts the token for storage.
authModal.statePlaceholder: Usually filled in automatically by "Authorize"; otherwise copy it from the callback page
authModal.codePlaceholder: Paste the code from the callback page
authModal.codeStateRequired: Please provide both the authorization code and state

message.testFail: The connection test did not pass

error.loadList: Failed to load the connection list
